name: Niyogin Fintech Limited
about: Niyogin Fintech Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a non-banking finance company in India. It operates through Financing Related Activities and Technology Related Activities segments. The company operates integrated platform that delivers embedded banking and financial technology solutions to banks, NBFCs, FinTechs, and other regulated financial institutions; Moneymap, an investment platform that offers financial advisory services; and SuperScan, an AI-enabled toolkit that employs optical recognition technology to convert unstructured data into structured input. It also provides loans, such as unsecured working capital and business loans, supply chain loans, and other short duration and secured loans; financial services business, including investment business, lending, advisory, and consultation; wealth products, such as mutual funds, bonds, corporate deposits, unlisted securities, PMS, etc.; and reporting and analytical tools to other private wealth outfits. In addition, the company is engaged in the business of providing payment solutions and services related to online and offline payment systems through software and hardware technology products. The company was formerly known as M3 Global Finance Limited and changed its name to Niyogin Fintech Limited in June 2017. Niyogin Fintech Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Mumbai, India.
